page.layout: One title page, centred. From top to bottom: title lines in roman capitals with a Greek word, italic "Quam" and dedication lines, the printer's name and place in the middle, a decorative woodcut ornament below the presenter's line, and the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: dignissimo, Præceptore ac Mœcenate suo nullis

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the "Ad diem" line and the printer's line: a wreath of laurel leaves held by two winged putti reclining at either side, printed in black. Not transcribed as text. Handwriting: "16" in pencil at top right, a pencilled mark beside "ALBINO", and a pencilled "A-3'925'240" below the imprint. Library stamp text "Universitätsbibliothek Bern / Zentralbibliothek" at the foot. None of these are printed text, so they are left out. The word "Publico" is read as printed; a faint pencil stroke runs through the line above it but does not obscure the letters.
